room_combine_request.note: Combine requests raised from a Room.

second_look_action.note: Second Look review, dismiss and reopen.

development_plan_write.note: Development Plan creates, edits and sharing changes.

development_item_write.note: Development goal, action and evidence-link writes.

box_cv_ready_check.note: Box Cam CV Ready Check runs.

contact_send.note: Contacts sent to players and guardians.

trial_invite.note: Trial invitations sent to players and guardians.

trial_schedule.note: Trial schedules proposed, revised or cancelled.

trial_response.note: Trial schedule confirmations, declines and cancellations by a player or guardian.

offer_draft_write.note: Offer drafts created, edited or revised.

offer_issue.note: Offers issued to players and guardians.

offer_response.note: Offer acceptances and declines by a player or guardian.

signing_start.note: Signing packages opened over accepted Offers.

signing_document_write.note: Signing documents attached, drafts edited, packages presented or superseded.

signing_party_completion.note: A party confirming the exact signing document (player, or the club signatory).

signing_safety_closure.note: Signings cancelled or voided by the club: a safety closure with its own budget, so completion traffic cannot exhaust it.

trial_evidence_link.note: Box Cam sessions linked to a Trial.

decision_finalize.note: Formal recruitment decisions finalized or superseded.

agent_representation_request.note: Representation relationship requests that reach a player lookup (malformed input and the agent's own verification refusals do not count).

agent_player_lookup.note: Player lookups from the Agent workspace.

agent_profile_write.note: Agent profile edits and verification submissions.

agent_client_response.note: Relationship confirmations, declines, terminations and disputes by a player.

compliance_context_write.note: Compliance context creation, party additions and representation declarations by a licensed agent.

compliance_consent_request.note: Consent requests sent to parties by a licensed agent.

compliance_consent_response.note: Consent grants, declines and revocations by a party.

ts_policy_publish.note: Policy version proposals by a Trust & Safety administrator.

transaction_write.note: Transaction creation, party changes, representation bindings, terms and re-evaluations by a licensed agent.

transaction_status_write.note: Transaction status transitions and party confirmations.

transaction_document_write.note: Transaction document metadata by any party to a transaction.

transaction_note_write.note: Scoped transaction notes by any party to a transaction.

opportunity_share.note: Opportunities an agent shares with a client, and withdrawals of them.

transaction_handoff.note: Transaction-workspace invitations a club issues from a recruitment case, and withdrawals of them.

login_failure.note: Failed sign-in attempts, per identifier tried. A successful sign-in costs nothing.

email_challenge_request.note: Club e-mail-domain verification codes requested (each one sends a mail).

email_challenge_confirm.note: Wrong club e-mail verification codes presented. A correct code costs nothing.

pairing_code_mint.note: Child pairing codes minted, per guardian.

pairing_attempt.note: Wrong child pairing codes presented, per client address (the route is unauthenticated). A correct code costs nothing.

evidence_request.note: Evidence requests to players and guardians.
